authoring: AI-assisted; user review pending, not independent human annotation
evidence_policy: Each gold item is one sufficient alternative; exact evidence substring in a source/page-matching chunk. No multi-hop cases. Added source and chunk_id are provenance.
heldout_policy: Use dev only to tune. Freeze selection rule and configuration before test. Test is newly authored versus Day06; authors inspected gold to label it, but no retrieval/model outputs have been used to tune against it. No automatic blind-test guarantee.
model_input: queries/{split}.json only, plus fixed corpus-only retrieval tools; never pass gold, expected_answer, answerable, absence_reason, review or annotation fields.
results: No ranking, context, agent output or score generated.

user_confirmation.scope: Step 2 benchmark accepted by user; AI-assisted labels confirmed, not independent blind annotation
